profile.name: Yaseer Maruf
profile.shortIntro: I build models and products that turn messy data into decisions people can trust.
profile.shortAbout: I'm a data scientist who likes the unglamorous parts of ML as much as the modeling — cleaning pipelines, writing tests, explaining results to people who don't care about your F1 score.
profile.longAbout: Over the past few years I've worked across the stack of a data science project: scoping the problem with stakeholders, wrangling and validating data, building and evaluating models, and shipping the result as something a non-technical team can actually use. I care about reproducibility and clear communication as much as model accuracy — a brilliant model nobody trusts doesn't get used. Outside of coursework and projects, I spend time in hackathons, open-source contributions, and writing about what I learn along the way.
